title: BrowseFolderRequest
description: Parameters for repository.browse, which opens the operating system's native folder picker. The renderer supplies the dialog title from its own string catalogue, because the host never authors user-facing prose.

title.description: Caption for the native dialog, already resolved to the user's language by the renderer.

initialDirectory.description: Directory the picker should start in. Omitted on first use, when there is no previous choice to return to.
